What should I do if the tracking never updates?
K9 Ballistics • AI Assistant
If tracking never updates, first check whether your order was split into multiple packages, because different tracking numbers can be involved. You can also view your order status by logging into your account on the site; if you didn’t create an account, one was created automatically using the email from checkout.
If you still do not have a tracking number yet, contact customer care with your order details so they can review it. Do not reply to order confirmation or status update emails, because those messages come from a no-reply inbox and your message will not be seen.
